## Experience

- Independent Software Engineering & AI Projects — Aug 2025 to present, Berlin, Germany. She
  left Moody's because she was relocating internationally, established herself in Berlin, then
  began focusing more deeply on applied AI and independent software projects:
  small applied-AI systems in Python, FastAPI, Postgres/Supabase, with retrieval, tool
  integrations, MCP-style typed tool boundaries, human approval flows, WhatsApp interfaces and
  observable Docker/VPS deployments. Since around March 2026 these projects have gone deeper into
  how small AI systems are deployed, monitored and operated. This is personal project work in the
  prototype stage, not a business: she does not offer consulting or services, and has no clients.
- Moody's Analytics — Apr 2023 to Aug 2025. Assistant Director, Software Engineer in Predictive
  Analytics, New York. Product engineering across EDF-X, Credit Analytics and Risk Scorecard. She personally
  implemented business and model-selection rules in Python, translating credit-domain requirements
  into production logic; built parts of the qualitative-overlay workflow as part of the engineering
  team; and contributed to stateful API and workflow design for long-running analytics. Primarily
  Python, plus TypeScript and Angular. She left in August 2025.
- JPMorgan Chase & Co. — Oct 2018 to Aug 2022. Software Engineer, Senior Associate, Asset
  Management, New York. Led frontend engineering and architecture for a derivatives
  portfolio-management application built on Athena, JPMorgan's cross-asset risk platform, and
  contributed across the backend and integration layers. Java, Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, C#.
  Contributed to decommissioning a legacy Trading, Risk and P&L platform for Fixed Income.
- Money.Net — Jan 2016 to Jun 2018. Software Engineer, financial markets terminal, Manhattan.
  Joined while the new terminal was being created, coded the initial frontend from scratch and
  contributed to parts of the backend. ReactJS, Java 8, WebSockets, gRPC, microservices, Python
  REST APIs, XMPP, for real-time, high-volume market data. Later architecture generations were
  team work.
- Independent Projects & Professional Development — Jan 2014 to Aug 2015, New York / travel.
  Freelance, personal and learning projects in JavaScript and Python while preparing for graduate
  study. Not a formal consulting business.
- DLYA Bantotal — Oct 2012 to May 2013. Technology Developer Consultant, core banking, Peru.
  GeneXus, credit-risk business issues, Oracle database and query analysis.

## This site's chat agent

The floating chat is Brenda's portfolio AI. It refers to her in the third person and
never roleplays as her — a deliberate design decision, not an oversight. Hybrid retrieval over a
Supabase Postgres corpus: full-text search plus pgvector embeddings, combined with
reciprocal rank fusion. A router step decides whether a question needs portfolio evidence, retrieved text
treated as evidence and never as instructions, server-issued sessions limited to three questions,
online scoring of every answer for quality, groundedness and safety, tracing and a prompt registry
via Langfuse with a local fallback prompt, and a CI-gated eval suite that must pass before a change
merges. It was built with AI-assisted development tools.

Eval categories: factual, boundary, attribution, status, retrieval, language.
The agent is intentionally constrained to the evidence in this portfolio and is tested against factual, attribution and safety regressions.

- There is no practice or consulting business. The applied-AI work is her own projects, mostly in
  the prototype stage. There are no clients, no consulting revenue and no production adoption.
- Casicornio has not launched. The first issues are being prepared; there is no meaningful
  subscriber base and no revenue.
- Moody's work was largely team work: she contributed to and built parts of it. She did not design
  the credit analytics architecture.
- Employer case studies describe the engineering problem and her contribution, never internal
  architecture, proprietary data flows or model internals.
- The 2010 fractal-dimension work was a research prototype, not a clinical diagnostic system.
- No total years-of-experience figure and no performance metrics are published on this site. The
